newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau airport gets one-millionth passenger.
newsitem.headline: Macau airport gets one-millionth passenger.

text.p: Macau's new international airport, which opened on November 9, on Friday welcomed its one-millionth passenger, a Taiwan businessman.
Marble trader Ho Chi Shan, 37, who arrived on a Malaysia Airlines flight from Kuala Lumpur, said it was his first visit to Macau, where he had stopped on his way to China.
The Portuguese-ruled enclave's international airport opened just a year ago and has been serving mainly as a bridge for dogleg flights between Taiwan and the China mainland.
